description: For-each / repetition primitive. Reads an array-shaped payload from its upstream node and runs the body sub-graph once per element, with configurable concurrency. Body nodes are tagged with the loop's id; the loop aggregates each iteration's exit-node output into a JSON array on its own folder for downstream consumers.

iterate.description: Iterate the upstream array, running the body sub-graph once per element.

fields.label: Array source filename
fields.description: Filename inside the upstream node's output folder containing the JSON array. Defaults to result.json.

fields.label: Array path (optional)
fields.description: Dotted JSON path to extract the array from the source file. Empty = root must be an array.

fields.label: Max parallel iterations
fields.description: Hard cap on how many iterations run in parallel. Default 4.

fields.label: On iteration failure
fields.description: fail-fast (default) — first failed iteration cancels the loop; continue — failed iterations are excluded from results.json, loop succeeds with warnings.
